output.reason: [ev-7eb7fed1368f] says only that new `flux reconcile|suspend|resume image policy` subcommands were added to the flux CLI changelog. The proposed exposure treats a CLI subcommand as a cli-flag, but cli-flag tests a container argument of the product's workloads, and the operator's CLI never runs these as a workload flag, so the condition could never match. The evidence names no environment state in which an operator who does nothing is affected by this purely additive feature, so no correct exposure condition follows from it.
